notes.title: Update: Combat improvements, optimization, bux fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, hellspawns![/h3]

[b][i]The Thespian Feast[/i] update is live on Steam:[/b]

-[u] [i][b]The Thespian Feast[/b][/i] is now on par with the main game[/u]. This is the first update since the launch of [i][b]Hellpoint[/b][/i], so it applies all the changes that were made to the main game over the past few weeks. 


[h3][b]Major changes to the combat system:[/b][/h3]

- Tweaked all the attack animations and hitbox activations
- Fixed environmental effects not being cleared upon respawning
- Fixed the splitscreen co-op revive not showing at the right spot
- Fixed firearm locking up in some situations
- Optimized horde spawning enemies
- Optimized the axion effect
- Reduced boss Ozyormy Goija slam's area of effect

[h3][b]Other changes:[/b][/h3]

- Lots of bug fixes
- General optimization

- Fixed the splitscreen co-op revive not showing at the right spot
- Fixed firearm locking up in some situations

notes.title: Update: Entangled ghost, shield mechanic tweaks, fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, community![/h3]

[b]The Thespian Feast update is live on Steam:[/b]

- An Entangled ghost of yourself is now roaming the space station if you die, be careful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822724/0cd484f46493a665b8da3c98ded9218e77253c49.gif[/img]
- Deploying your shield at the right moment now gives you a massive boost in deflection (Parry)
- Emotes now don't auto-populate the menu in medium class
- Removed the mind cube reader as its dialogs were not intended for the demo, replaced it with a nice weapon
- Added Omnicube tutorials
- Added sound on weapon leveling up
- Removed a somewhat recurring leather sound from the player soundbank
- Added more obvious warning when energy is too low to perform an ability, fire a gun, or use the Omnicube
- Speeded up dialog while adding delay on discussion choices
- Stopped enemies' abilities when they die
- Fixed an issue with hitting crates filling up your energy and healing you
- Fixed the modules Greed Sacrifice and Leech
- Fixed an issue with removing or adding stat boosting module tinning the stats screen values green or red
- Fixed a number of melee and firearm passive unlockable abilities that would fail to provide a proper stat boost
- Fixed where the motion sensitivity wouldn't go down to the minimum
- Fixed a case where the Omnicube transposition could trigger an endless loading screen in some cases
- Fixed the Warrior Saber missing its upgrade chip effects
- Fixed the player unable to fall for a split second after getting off a ladder
- Fixed an issue where the world wouldn't load after the player would respawn in a very specific spot in a pit
- Fixed the Black Hole door beam being misaligned
- Fixed a few walls missing collisions
- Fixed a case with enemies freezing in place after losing sight of the player
- Fixed a bug where the player would perish again after dying from a fall in a pit
- Fixed the horde enemy not having their spawning effect
- Fixed enemies popping in an out of the world

notes.title: Update: New opening section
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, community![/h3]

We continue to ignore sleep in any shape or form to further improve [b][i]The Thespian Feast[/i][/b]. Your feedback has been extremely helpful in a lot of ways, but one of the most important things we learned was that this chapter needed a proper [b][i]entry[/i][/b]. 

Having learned that, we decided to [b]rework the opening section of the demo[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822724/ebd649056b3a18d340f074c9c201c90f4f11aa8f.gif[/img]

[u]New point of entry, tweaked difficulty curve, improved tutorial[/u] are among the things that were added with this major update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822724/ce36fdab2972bfcce5bdfb02e3528d7e07a49dab.gif[/img]

[b]Other changes/fixes:[/b]

- Added an upgrade chip station. Now weapons can be upgraded
- Interacting with a breach now heals the player
- Made the player more self-aware when talking to himself
- The player can now start blocking as soon as they are out of a dodge invulnerability frames
- The end trailer has audio now!
- Fixed an issue where a ladder would fail to work if enemies were nearby
- Tweaked the loading screen visual
- Made it a lot harder to lose lock on enemies
- Fixed the tutorial about switching weapon abilities
- Fixed an issue that would prevent emotes from working in splitscreen
- Removed an unwanted emote
- Fixed the exception thrown by the alarm program
- Fixed the negative value in glass lighting
- Tutorial box now would auto-close if the player is attacked

Enjoy the updated chapter and be sure to let us know what you do or don't like. 

[b]See you![/b]

- Made the player more self-aware when talking to himself

- The end trailer has audio now!

notes.title: Day 2 Hotfix: boss fight, heavy weapons, healing
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, community![/h3]

Thanks for all of your feedback and bug reports, keep them flowing. We see that many of you appreciate the yesterday's improvements, which means we are on the right track. 

[b]Another step, another patch is live. What has been changed:[/b]

- Fixed the bug causing heavy weapon doing only 50% of their intended damage (yes, two times more viable now, give it a try)
- Tweaked Ozy's attacks (boss fight is much better now as well)
- Raised the number of maximum available healing charges from 3 to 5
- Fixed an issue where taken attack would trigger controller vibration twice
- Fixed an issue where selecting a class with the mouse would give twice the items to the player

[url=https://discord.gg/hellpoint]Join our Discord[/url]. Feel free to suggest what we should focus on in the upcoming updates. Thanks everyone for the support!

notes.title: Second Hotfix of Day 1: Bugs, more difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, community![/h3]

Thanks for the feedback, everyone! We have seen some rough criticism, but we have also seen genuine interest in Hellpoint and its universe - and that's what really matters to us. We would keep going to make sure both [i][b]Hellpoint[/b][/i] and [b][i]Hellpoint: The Thespian Feast[/i][/b] provide the great experience - step by step, and side by side with all of you.

After a day of hard work we are excited to inform you we took another step, and the second patch went live about an hour ago. We did another bunch of balancing tweaks for a smoother difficulty curve, fixed lots of bugs, and covered several other things, all according to your requests. 

[b]Here’s what has been changed:[/b]

- Fixed the field of view having issues while the player is insane
- Fixed Windows 7/8 crashes
- Lowered the minimum available mouse sensitivity 
- Added feedback in level up menu when low on axions
- Fixed a sticky door in docking bay
- Reduced enemy count in docking bay key room
- Fixed old switches not talking to the player
- Prevented enemies to target the player while in class selection menu
- Lowered level up cost for the demo (-60 levels)
- Raised maximum healing count from 2 to 3
- Tweaked boss Ozy's damage and hitboxes
- Tweaked heavy weapons damage
- Updated localization

The next update is on its way, and many others will follow, so please don't hesitate to help us out with your observations and opinions. Communicate with us here and [url=https:://discord.gg/hellpoint]join our Discord[/url]! We are always active there. 

[b]Thanks for your support![/b]

- Fixed Windows 7/8 crashes

- Added feedback in level up menu when low on axions

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix: balancing, difficulty issues
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, community! [/h3]

First of all, we'd like to thank you for being among the first to try [i][b]The Thespian Feast[/b][/i] 
and let us know what you think. Your feedback is extremely important and helps us make Hellpoint a better game.

We went through your initial reviews carefully and are happy to report that the hotfix is now available, addressing some urgent changes and also dealing with some critical bugs. 

[b]Here’s what has been changed:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Rebalanced enemy encounters at the beginning of the level, some enemies were also nerfed
[*]Raised the weapon upgrade level to +8 as +1 turned out to be too low
[*]Fixed the issue with cube programs not switching properly
[*]Fixed the issue related to loading the old configuration file from the 2017 Kickstarter demo (for those who played it)
[*]Added an upgrade chip to the Railgun
[*]We will have a second smaller update shortly to change the base damage of the Railgun
[/olist]
Thank you for your patience and support! We will continue to work as hard as we can to make Hellpoint the best possible experience for you. If you run across any issues, don’t hesitate to tell us here or on our official [url=https://discord.gg/hellpoint]Discord server[/url].

Raised the weapon upgrade level to +8 as +1 turned out to be too low

Fixed the issue related to loading the old configuration file from the 2017 Kickstarter demo (for those who played it)
